policy: External data lives under external_data/<scene_id>/ (never committed). Archives are untrusted data: extracted with safe extractors, never executed. Every downloaded file is size-checked against the server Content-Length recorded here and SHA-256 logged in external_data/downloads.jsonl. Roles: 'development' scenes may be used to tune the pipeline; 'heldout_test' scenes are run ONCE with the frozen configuration (datasets/FROZEN_CONFIG.json) and never used for tuning.

datasets.name: ETH3D high-resolution multi-view stereo benchmark (training split)
datasets.license_source: eth3d.net (recorded in Phase 12, SRC-231); non-commercial; derivatives must be shared alike
datasets.access: Public direct HTTPS download, no registration
datasets.modality: Real photographs: 24 MP DSLR JPEGs (6048 x 4032), indoor and outdoor scenes
datasets.ground_truth: Laser scans (Faro, mm-level) in the dataset frame; ground-truth camera intrinsics and poses (COLMAP text format)
datasets.redistribution: Allowed only non-commercially, with attribution, under the same licence. Not redistributed by this repository; derived meshes are kept local.
datasets.citation: T. Schops et al., A Multi-View Stereo Benchmark with High-Resolution Images and Multi-Camera Videos, CVPR 2017

scenes.description: Indoor room with table-football table, 31 images. Phase 12 baseline (EXP-014/015/016).
intended_experiments: baseline already run in Phase 12; re-run only through the new app pipeline for regression
scenes.hardware_feasibility: Measured Phase 12: SfM 206 s / 7.85 GB peak (4 threads); dense+mesh+texture 27 min / 4.83 GB peak

scenes.description: Small indoor scene (pipes and machinery), 14 images. Fast smoke test of the full pipeline.
intended_experiments: pose and geometry accuracy vs laser
scenes.hardware_feasibility: 14 images: expected well under the kicker cost
scenes.limitations: Close-range scene, not a walkable room; navigation metrics not meaningful.

scenes.description: Indoor office, 26 images, large textureless walls and floor (known hard case).
intended_experiments: floor and obstacle extraction vs laser reference
scenes.limitations: Textureless surfaces; expected weak dense coverage.

scenes.description: Indoor delivery area / hall, 44 images, large open floor with pallets and objects.
intended_experiments: walkable floor IoU, obstacle omission, route success and collision vs laser reference

datasets.name: ARKitScenes (raw split): handheld iPad Pro captures of real homes
datasets.license: Apple ARKitScenes licence (LICENSE file in the repository): non-commercial use, reproduction, modification and redistribution with the notice retained; separate commercial terms
datasets.access: Public direct HTTPS download from docs-assets.developer.apple.com, no registration. URL pattern taken from the official download_data.py; that script itself is not executed.
datasets.modality: Real handheld mobile-device video (.mov, iPad Pro wide camera) plus ARKit camera trajectory, LiDAR-derived ARKit mesh and human-annotated 3D object boxes
datasets.ground_truth: Independent of our RGB pipeline: ARKit trajectory (VIO, metric), ARKit LiDAR mesh (metric, cm-level), annotated oriented 3D boxes of furniture (bed, sofa, table, chair, cabinet, ...)
datasets.redistribution: Non-commercial only with the Apple notice. Not redistributed by this repository.
datasets.citation: G. Baruch et al., ARKitScenes: A Diverse Real-World Dataset for 3D Indoor Scene Understanding Using Mobile RGB-D Data, NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks

scenes.description: Validation video 41069048 (visit 381644), sky direction Up; smallest upright validation video with annotations. Content: bathroom (bathtub, toilet, sink) - small, reflective, a known hard case.
intended_experiments: video ingestion and deterministic frame extraction
scenes.hardware_feasibility: Video decode with ffmpeg; frames subsampled to <= 150 at <= 1920 px
scenes.limitations: iPad Pro, not iPhone 12; ARKit mesh is a sensor reconstruction, not a laser scan.

scenes.description: Validation video 41142280 (visit 384651, a different home), sky direction Up. Content: bathroom (bathtub, toilet, sink) - small, reflective, a known hard case.
intended_experiments: held-out mobile-video run with the frozen configuration

scenes.description: Validation video 41125700 (visit 382321): open-plan living room / kitchen (2 sofas, 3 tables, 4 chairs, cabinets), sky direction Up.
intended_experiments: video ingestion on a furnished home
scenes.limitations: iPad Pro, not iPhone 12; ARKit mesh is a sensor reconstruction, not a laser scan; annotation covers furniture classes only (no walls / small objects).

scenes.description: Validation video 41069025 (visit 381658, a different home): living room / kitchen (sofa, 4 tables, 2 chairs, cabinets), sky direction Up.
intended_experiments: video ingestion on a furnished home
scenes.limitations: iPad Pro, not iPhone 12; ARKit mesh is a sensor reconstruction, not a laser scan; annotation covers furniture classes only (no walls / small objects).

datasets.name: TUM RGB-D SLAM benchmark
datasets.license_source: https://cvg.cit.tum.de/data/datasets/rgbd-dataset (read 2026-10-11): 'Unless stated otherwise, all data in the TUM RGB-D benchmark is licensed under a Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution License (CC BY 4.0)'
datasets.access: Public direct HTTPS download, no registration (redirects to webshare.cvg.cit.tum.de)
datasets.modality: Real handheld Kinect-class RGB-D video as 640 x 480 PNG frames at 30 Hz, motion-capture ground-truth trajectory
datasets.ground_truth: Motion-capture camera trajectory (metric); per-frame depth images (independent sensor)
datasets.redistribution: Allowed with attribution (CC BY 4.0). A small frame subset is redistributed as the repository sample in samples/tum_fr3_office/ with attribution.
datasets.citation: J. Sturm et al., A Benchmark for the Evaluation of RGB-D SLAM Systems, IROS 2012

scenes.description: fr3/long_office_household: 87 s handheld loop around two desks in an office.
scenes.limitations: Low resolution, rolling shutter, auto exposure; desk-scale rather than room-scale; no floor reference.
